title: Data and finality
rule: Validate symbol, feed, supported chart, finalized bars and sufficient warm-up.
evidence: Feed, symbol, candle close, warm-up status.

title: Confirmed structure
rule: Identify confirmed swing pairs, direction and protected level. The exact structural model is proposed.
gate: Enough confirmed structure under the approved model.
evidence: 4SH/HH or LH; 4SL/HL or LL; protection; confirmation time.

title: Direction permission
rule: 4H authorizes direction. Lower timeframes cannot override it.
gate: Bullish or bearish permission; neutral/unknown blocks new directional qualification.

title: S/R or S/D zone
rule: Locate eligible support/resistance OR supply/demand. S/R is missing; S/D detection is a research proposal.
gate: Active eligible source-owned zone. S/D requires its own timeframe close beyond the buffered edge to invalidate.
evidence: Zone ID, source TF, boundaries, 30% buffer, validity.

title: Pullback at location
rule: Identify P2 retracement into the eligible location; exact phase/contact mechanics remain open.
gate: Approved location contact and valid parent 4H permission.
evidence: Pullback interval, zone contact, source candle.

title: Directional SPA
rule: Any one pin rejection, engulfing or piercing at the location in the 4H direction. S/D candidates exist; full setup qualification does not.
gate: Location AND any one approved pattern AND HTF alignment.
evidence: Pattern, contact evidence, 1H closed candle, direction.

title: Qualified setup handoff
rule: Create and maintain a setup ID linking 4H permission, location and 1H SPA. Lifecycle policies need definition.
gate: Qualified setup remains current; invalid parents block downstream stages.
evidence: Setup ID, HTF version, zone ID, creation and invalidation policy.

title: CHoCH
rule: Wait for a qualified change of character linked to the setup. Existing research labels are not a completed execution gate.
gate: Approved directional CHoCH event after eligible setup.
evidence: Broken reference, close/wick policy, confirmation, setup ID.

title: Separate swing break
rule: Require the distinct swing break after CHoCH; do not count one event twice.
gate: Approved second structure event in the required order.
evidence: Separate swing reference and event ID.

title: Retest and extreme
rule: Accept the retest under agreed tolerance, depth and timeout rules; preserve its extreme for the stop.
gate: Retest valid and linked to the broken level.

title: Signal candle
rule: Confirm the qualifying candle after the retest; exact pattern definition remains open.
gate: Approved finalized signal candle and current setup.
evidence: OHLC, candle time, direction and pattern.

title: Williams Fractal gate
rule: Combined only: add confirmed continuation evidence. Long: prior HH/HL then LH high fractal; short: prior LH/LL then HL low fractal. Generic pivots are insufficient.
gate: Full baseline plus eligible confirmed fractal. Final pre-arm check is proposed; timing/age/expiry policy remains OPEN.
evidence: Pivot origin, right-bar confirmation, publication, precursor references, setup ID.

title: Entry, stop and ≥2R
rule: Entry one tick beyond the signal candle; stop beyond retest extreme; minimum 2R opportunity. No one-pip or 1R substitution.
gate: All gates pass, positive risk and approved target opportunity. Undefined policy blocks the plan.
evidence: Frozen signal entry, retest stop, target, tick size, initial R.

title: Arm / expire / cancel
rule: Track a plan with three-bar expiry and explicit cancellation. Exact counting and event precedence remain open. Indicator submits no orders.
gate: All mandatory rules defined and valid at arming; never retroactively arm.
evidence: Arming time, expiry clock, parent validity, cancellation reason.

title: Hypothetical trigger
rule: Track the plan trigger separately from an actual broker fill. Gaps and same-bar path need test-harness assumptions.
gate: Trigger occurs while eligible under approved timing.
evidence: Trigger time, planned price, execution assumptions.

title: 50% TP1 → runner → exit
rule: Depict 50% at TP1 and retain the runner. Target mapping, runner stop/exit and rounding policy remain open.
gate: Only approved management rules can transition the tracked state.
evidence: TP1, partial quantity, remaining size, runner policy, exit reason.
